title: Finite semigroup lift audit after PAH-OMC-013 generator intertwining
question: Does the exact PAH-OMC-013 eventual pointwise generator identity exponentiate to P_(n+1)(t) I_(n,n+1) f = I_(n,n+1) P_n(t) f for the unchanged finite PAH stationary semigroups, without adding a new dynamics or a cross-Q state?

exact_scope.model: Exactly the immutable PAH-001 finite configuration spaces, original directed roots, midpoint rates, labelled Gibbs components and external stochastic Markov time, with the PAH-OMC-012 graded union and PAH-OMC-013 grade-blind lift.
exact_scope.finite_pair: Fix one finite successor pair (n,n+1), one positive R, and one grade-blind cylinder f with n>=N(f). No volume, cutoff, beta, continuum or observation limit is taken.
exact_scope.operators: A=L_(n+1) and B=L_n act on the finite bounded-function spaces; I=I_(n,n+1) is the pointwise projection pullback from PAH-OMC-013. P_k(t)=exp(t L_k) denotes only the original finite backward Markov semigroup.
exact_scope.registered_input: R-493 proves A I f=I B f for each declared cylinder f after its support-dependent N(f), and retains the R-484 hidden-diagonal defect 16/9. It does not register an invariant finite subspace or an all-function operator identity.
exact_scope.target_identity: The desired fixed-pair bridge is P_(n+1)(t) I f=I P_n(t)f for all t>=0. This bridge is a finite operator statement only; it is not the anchored-n limit in PAH-OMC-020.

finite_bridge_theorem.sufficient_hypothesis: If I is a linear map on the entire finite coarse function space and A I=I B on that entire space, then A^k I=I B^k for every k>=0 and the finite matrix-exponential semigroups satisfy exp(tA)I=I exp(tB) for every real t.
finite_bridge_theorem.local_variant: For a subspace C, the same conclusion for f in C requires B^k f to remain in C and A I h=I B h for every h=B^k f. A first-order identity for one f is not sufficient.
finite_bridge_theorem.proof_route: Induct on k for powers, then use the absolutely convergent finite-dimensional exponential series (or the equivalent unique linear ODE). The Lean lane formalizes the power-intertwining induction and the coefficient-wise exponential consequence; the analytic finite-dimensional series theorem is an explicit inherited input, not an infinite-volume claim.

closure_audit.support_rule: R-493 sets N(f)=max(2,m_f+1) and only asserts the identity at the support-dependent threshold.
closure_audit.iterate_requirement: To exponentiate the local statement one must register a common invariant subspace or prove the identity for every iterate B^k f at the same fixed pair. The current R-493 packet contains neither field.
closure_audit.boundary_role: The R-484 16/9 defect is separated from a stabilized first-order cylinder support; it is not a proof that every iterated generator remains separated.
closure_audit.classification: This is a missing-hypothesis audit, not an exact PAH counterexample to a finite semigroup identity. It prevents promotion of R-493 to a semigroup theorem until the invariant/iterate condition is source-authorized.

acceptance.primary: Hash-pin PAH-001, OMC-012, OMC-013 and R493-Lean; prove the finite power/exponential implication; replay exact rational matrix identities; and verify that R-493 has no registered invariant-core/all-iterate field.
acceptance.independent: Rebuild the finite algebra theorem and the support-dependent closure audit without importing the primary matrix values; use different small exact matrices and iterate depths.
acceptance.hostile: Reject treating a derivative-at-zero identity as a semigroup identity, silently replacing the local cylinder by the full finite function space, reusing a fixed N(f) after generator iteration, or promoting the finite bridge to anchored-n, path-space or physical closure.
acceptance.lean: Formalize power-intertwining by induction, the finite coefficient identity for exponential series, the need for an invariant subspace in the local variant, and the no-promotion firewall.

missing_assumptions: A source-authorized invariant finite common subspace containing the iterates of every target cylinder at the fixed successor pair, or an exact all-function operator identity A I=I B.
A source-authorized definition of the transition-kernel/projective consistency if the semigroup is to be used pathwise instead of through finite matrix exponentials.
The separate common-space/path-space, N2b/N2c/N4/N2d and R-512 minimal-form identification inputs required for anchored-n convergence.
non_claims: R-550 does not prove the PAH-OMC-020 ordered j-before-anchored-n semigroup convergence.
The conditional finite bridge does not construct a common infinite-volume process, a path law, or a closed operator from the PAH source.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event horizon, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
Markov time remains the external stochastic time declared in PAH-001 and is not quantum real time, proper time or Lorentzian time.
The finite matrix regression fixtures are algebraic checks and are not replacement PAH carriers, counterterms, rates or state mixtures.
falsifiers: A hash-pinned R-493 packet already contains a source-authorized invariant finite subspace or all-function operator identity omitted by this audit.
A valid exact PAH state and observable violates the conditional finite power/exponential implication under its stated hypotheses.
The Lean power or coefficient theorem fails under the pinned toolchain.
The result is reported as an anchored-n, path-space, continuum or physical theorem without the missing owner fields.
single_next_question: Can a source-authorized packet prove that the R-493 grade-blind cylinder is invariant under every finite coarse generator iterate, or provide the stronger all-function finite operator intertwining needed to exponentiate the lift?
revisit_condition: Reopen when that one invariant/iterate packet is hash-pinned, or when an exact unchanged-PAH finite state/observable gives a genuine second-order semigroup defect; do not repeat physical-empty, BCC or Reading-H calculations.
